measurement_notes: Server spans are max completed_at minus min created_at across persisted report rows; observer and read-only collection delays are excluded. Exact microsecond differences are retained.
Reported token usage covers successful provider responses only. Failed-attempt usage and any provider billing for it are unknown.

queue_ms on recovered calls omits any scheduler wait belonging to failed transport attempts; logical latency includes retries. Reported queue_ms is not a complete decomposition of recovered-call latency.
Counts exclude the separate intentionally aborted intervention-control run and the coordinator's concurrent browser runs.
Per-run server span includes durable workshop job wait; it is not model-only latency.
